query: SELECT jsonb_build_object('product_id',r.source_id,'document_id',d.id,'title',d.title,'source','merchant-document') AS "document!" FROM knowledge_relations r JOIN products p ON p.tenant=r.tenant AND p.id=r.source_id JOIN knowledge_documents d ON d.tenant=r.tenant AND d.id=r.target_id AND d.visibility='public' AND NOT d.archived WHERE r.tenant=$1 AND r.kind='HAS_DOCUMENT' ORDER BY r.source_id,d.id LIMIT 100
